data.name: Button / Primary
data.description: Primary action button with a leading icon. Full width in the sidebar; hug width in compose footers; icon-only (Show label off) in collapsed and mobile nav.

data.name: Avatar
data.description: Circular sender avatar showing initials. Used in the thread sender row.

data.name: Reply bar
data.description: Placeholder field at the bottom of a thread for writing a reply.

data.name: Folder row
data.description: Sidebar folder entry with icon, name and unread count. Selected marks the open folder; icon-only when Show label is off.

data.name: Thread row
data.description: Conversation row in the thread list: sender, time, subject and one-line preview. Selected marks the thread open in the reading pane; Unread shows the dot.

data.name: Icon / inbox
data.description: Inbox folder icon, 20 px, stroke 1.67.

data.name: Icon / archive
data.description: Archive folder icon, 20 px, stroke 1.67.

data.name: Icon / pencil
data.description: Compose (pencil) icon, 20 px, stroke 1.67.

data.name: Icon / sidebar-collapse
data.description: Collapse-sidebar icon for the expanded rail header, 20 px.

data.name: Icon / sidebar-expand
data.description: Expand-sidebar icon for the collapsed rail and the mobile nav toggle, 20 px.

data.name: Sidebar
data.description: Primary navigation. Expanded and Collapsed are the desktop/tablet rail; Expanded right is the mobile floating icon pill with labels.

data.name: Icon / search
data.description: Search icon for the search bar, 20 px.

data.name: Search bar
data.description: Pill search field with a search icon and placeholder. Fixed 480 on desktop, fills the top bar elsewhere.

data.name: Icon / send
data.description: Send icon for the compose Send button, 20 px.

data.name: Compose field
data.description: Labelled single-line field in the compose pane (To, Subject). Fixed-width label, value fills the row.

data.name: Icon / chevron-left
data.description: Left chevron for the Back link, 20 px.

data.name: Back link
data.description: Back navigation to the inbox on single-pane tablet and mobile screens.

data.name: Icon / sidebar-collapse-right
data.description: Close icon of the mobile nav pill, 20 px.

data.name: Nav toggle
data.description: Mobile button that opens the navigation. Sits right of the search bar in the bottom bar.

data.name: Surface/Paper
data.description: Paper grain. Reading surfaces only, never the nav.

data.name: Elevation/Overlay
data.description: Panels floating over content.
